properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-23 (0.90.0, the heat rung's committed fixture): a reply held to N by reply_budget is printed over N. `--call` and `--describe` print the reply pretty-printed, and a client on the `duplicate` content policy gets the payload pretty-printed in its text block, while every budget counts compact JSON
properties.statement:
Reproduced on main a830817e7, debug build, store imported from crates/reflow2-core/tests/fixtures/proof_trial_heat_equation.json. reasoning_report on req:thm-uniqueness:
- held to budget_chars 30,000: compact payload 27,227; printed by --call 35,087 (17% over the budget it was held to);
- held to 60,000: compact 56,731; printed 73,497 (22% over; 30% over the payload).
The door prints serde_json::to_string_pretty (main.rs, call_one_tool and the --describe path), and content_policy::apply(Duplicate) puts to_string_pretty of the payload in the text block, while reply_budget::chars_of counts compact JSON. The '47% over' remembered from PR #788 was not found as a node; this is the reproduction.
FIX (PR B, feat/replies-fit): both print compact JSON, so what is printed is what the budget measured.
